repaid_items.description: `PresetResolver` only supported `manual_select` and had no deterministic suggestion path
repaid_items.result: Added deterministic offline `suggest()` while keeping execution explicit

repaid_items.description: `HandoffLite` was frozen only as a contract and not persisted
repaid_items.result: Added persistence plus `status-detail`, `handoffs`, smoke, and offline-validation coverage

repaid_items.description: thin compile existed only as an internal placeholder and not as a public lifecycle surface
repaid_items.result: Added explicit public `compile / recompile / resume` lifecycle surfaces

repaid_items.description: execution initially relied on a shell-only lane with no stable GPT-capable CLI route
repaid_items.result: `WorkerRouter`, multi-route capability selection, adapter pinning, `NoopAdapter`, and `OpenCodeAdapter` now provide a real multi-adapter execution baseline

repaid_items.description: `packages/core_domain/services.py` concentrated too much orchestration, projection, memory, simulation, and lifecycle logic in one file
repaid_items.result: Extracted bounded service modules for projection/reporting, memory/simulation, and lifecycle/review while keeping `OrchestratorService` as the public facade

repaid_items.description: subprocess-backed adapters did not enforce declared timeout budgets and inherited too much parent environment state
repaid_items.result: Added timeout enforcement, subprocess env allowlisting, interpreter-portable compile commands, and explicit local execution trust-boundary docs

repaid_items.description: `infra/scripts/offline_validation.py` had grown into an oversized validation script instead of a modular validation package
repaid_items.result: Split validation flows into `infra/validation/` modules and reduced `offline_validation.py` to a thin entry wrapper

repaid_items.description: runtime-brief and memory-retrieval assembly lacked a hard context-budget preflight and explicit pruning guard path
repaid_items.result: Added diagnostics-first `context_budget`, gateway preflight guarding, trace context, and ADR-006 for the next-step pruning strategy

repaid_items.description: key runtime dependencies were pinned with narrow upper bounds, making routine compatibility and security updates harder than necessary
repaid_items.result: Widened core runtime upper bounds selectively and documented the repository's dependency/versioning policy before `M8`

repaid_items.description: governance reports parsed Markdown debt prose directly instead of consuming a structured canonical source
repaid_items.result: Added canonical JSON governance sources with Markdown compatibility fallback and explicit source-contract reporting

repaid_items.description: clean source-package/export flow was not productized, so review or handoff snapshots could include local state, DBs, artifacts, and repo noise
repaid_items.result: Added source-package manifest/export tooling, minimal automation gates, and freeze-review provenance for handoff claims

repaid_items.description: canonical repo docs mixed local absolute links and current/historical guidance without a portable source map
repaid_items.result: Finished portable-link cleanup for living docs and formalized current-vs-historical doc governance in the active workflow guide

repaid_items.description: review policy breadth stopped at `auto_only`, `recommended`, `human_required`, and `mandatory`; `optional` was reference-only
repaid_items.result: Added executable `optional` advisory-review runtime behavior, seed coverage, and governance/readiness parity

repaid_items.description: `run_events` and trace export lacked replay-grade linkage and first-class run metrics
repaid_items.result: Added replay-packet projection, end-to-end run metrics, and richer audit/status observability surfaces

repaid_items.description: the durable pilot still lacked explicit interrupt/resume/checkpoint lineage and reconciliation semantics
repaid_items.result: Added structured durable lineage history, durable transition inspection, and terminal/review checkpoint reconciliation

repaid_items.description: governance visibility remained document-centric and lacked quantitative automation and alerts
repaid_items.result: Added quantitative governance metrics, automated alert reports, and updated release-readiness integration

repaid_items.description: claim and worker-lease semantics remained local-only and did not provide explicit repository-owned ownership topology
repaid_items.result: Added explicit claim/worker ownership topology, attempt-aware claim and lease linkage, coherent ownership projections, and local batch-domain semantics without turning the runtime into a multi-node scheduler

repaid_items.description: execution semantics were still serial-first and did not implement claim/lease/barrier-aware local batch concurrency
repaid_items.result: Added local batch-barrier events, parallel batch resume semantics, projection surfaces, and CLI/API batch-resume entry points for the supported local control plane

repaid_items.description: the full operator web UI and human control surface were still missing beyond CLI/API and the read-mostly TUI
repaid_items.result: Added a built-in FastAPI web operator surface with dashboard, run explorer, pending-review console, governance/config pages, and controller-owned human action routes

repaid_items.description: hosted remote worker pools and multi-node scheduling were still not productized beyond the shipped local-first / loopback external-worker baseline
repaid_items.result: Added single-control-plane remote HTTP worker pools, callback-driven lease renewal/completion recording, remote worker bootstrap packaging, and remote worker recovery coverage while keeping repository truth in the control plane

repaid_items.description: a centralized scheduler-authority first slice existed for multi-control-plane identity, lease proposal, and arbitration provenance, but true distributed scheduler consensus and cross-control-plane failover were still incomplete
repaid_items.result: Added a single-store quorum-style scheduler-authority layer, committed cross-control-plane lease ownership, fencing-token enforced remote callbacks, takeover handoff lineage, cluster operator surfaces, and offline cutover validation while keeping repository truth inside the control planes

repaid_items.description: post-`M31 Phase 0` truth was still partially duplicated across freeze reviews, the current workflow guide, retained phase/task-card artifacts, and root rebaseline bundles until the opening material was fully absorbed and pruned
repaid_items.result: Absorbed the opening-bundle and backup-workspace truth into accepted freeze reviews and archive notes, then cleaned the repository back to one primary worktree

repaid_items.description: orchestration logic still carried `project_delivery`-shaped assumptions even after the first shared graph substrate extraction
repaid_items.result: Contracted default planning, preview, and execution onto a shared orchestration service and canonical plan builder for the shipped multi-role presets

repaid_items.description: `CodexAdapter` assembled `codex exec` with prompt/options ordering and Windows text handling that could break model selection or artifact output
repaid_items.result: Codex CLI execution now passes options before prompt, uses stdin for real prompts, decodes UTF-8 safely, creates artifact directories, and supports bounded local timeout overrides

repaid_items.description: orchestration child failures could be silently approved as completed, hiding non-zero evidence during fallback
repaid_items.result: Failed child runs now stay failed or are rejected before fallback; successful artifact-only child runs can be approved only when return_code is zero

repaid_items.description: local Codex CLI could not access the desired dogfood model version before the CLI upgrade
repaid_items.result: Upgraded npm `@openai/codex` to `0.125.0`; local `codex exec --model gpt-5.5` smoke succeeded

repaid_items.description: Codex CLI on Windows could leave node/native child processes alive after workflow timeout, causing long dogfood runs to hang
repaid_items.result: Real Codex CLI execution now uses process-tree timeout cleanup; the M42 management-cluster tree-timeout smoke completed with no residual `codex.exe`

repaid_items.description: ShellAdapter captured subprocess output in text mode with the platform default encoding, which could fail or corrupt Chinese/UTF-8 artifact output on Windows
repaid_items.result: ShellAdapter now captures bytes and decodes with UTF-8 plus system-codepage fallback; Chinese artifact stdout is covered by regression tests

repaid_items.description: Dynamic multi-cluster launches selected several clusters, but status detail projected only the first cluster graph
repaid_items.result: Cluster preview now builds a composite graph with all selected cluster_template_ids and per-cluster subgraphs

repaid_items.description: `OrchestratorService` and adjacent CLI/Web/chat surfaces still concentrated too much behavior behind large facade files
repaid_items.result: Reduced `services.py` below the 2600-line ratchet, capped direct facade methods at <=120, split interaction services, converted chat runtime into a package facade, split CLI command families, and split the Web UI shell with receipt-gated high-risk actions

repaid_items.description: scheduler-authority naming and docs could overstate consensus-style guarantees beyond the local-first lease semantics
repaid_items.result: Documented `LocalSchedulerLeaseArbiter` as the default local lease arbiter and retained scheduler-authority names only as legacy compatibility or explicit cluster-on surfaces

repaid_items.description: capability health still relied too much on descriptor readiness instead of runtime probe evidence
repaid_items.result: Added `CapabilityProbeResult`, runtime ledger evidence, API/CLI health projection, and require-live probes that passed for shell, Codex, OpenCode, MMX, Vertex, Claude, and LangChain

repaid_items.description: future platform objects from the M31 bundle and ZIP lacked a governed promotion path into current contracts
repaid_items.result: Classified these objects as archived reference material outside the active local-personal runtime scope; no current contract claims them ready, and any future promotion must start with a new explicit governance task

repaid_items.description: multi-agent dogfood capability claims still depended on degraded/fallback paths for several provider lanes
repaid_items.result: `workflowctl capability probe --provider all --require-live` passed for shell, Codex, OpenCode, MMX, Vertex, Claude, and LangChain with evidence under `state/m61_m66_execution/capability_probes/`

repaid_items.description: Codex CLI review/doc artifact-only roles could be slow and lacked role-level latency diagnostics
repaid_items.result: Shrank dogfood artifact prompts by capping runtime brief, handoff context, and responsibility lists, and added role-level prompt telemetry to Codex execution metadata with regression coverage

repaid_items.description: MMX/Vertex multimodal lanes were modeled but lacked live primary-path evidence
repaid_items.result: Require-live capability probes produced successful MMX and Vertex evidence; missing credentials or fallback-only results are no longer accepted as closeout success

repaid_items.description: OperatorActionReceipt validated action/workspace/ttl/single-use but did not bind the confirmed receipt to the actual request scope through scope_hash or scope_payload
repaid_items.result: Added scope_hash and scope_payload to the contract/DB/repository, bound high-risk API/UI/chat receipt consumption to actual run/body/session scope, rejected legacy receipts without scope_hash, and moved watchdog auto-apply from mutating GET to POST plus receipt

repaid_items.description: Capability live probes could accept generic, simulated, dry-run, or fallback-only provider output as verified readiness for non-codex/opencode providers
repaid_items.result: Added provider-specific M67 live-proof contracts, rejected generic/simulated/dry-run/fallback-only evidence, forced Codex/OpenCode/Claude/LangChain probe paths to emit scoped proof after real backend execution, and passed require-live probes for shell, Codex, OpenCode, MMX, Vertex, Claude, and LangChain

repaid_items.description: offline validation was not shardable/freshness-safe enough; timeout paths could leave stale success reports available to operators
repaid_items.result: Added quick/full/shard validation entrypoints, per-flow timeout reports with command traces and last-command evidence, result-file subprocess transfer to avoid Windows multiprocessing Queue deadlocks, a quick CLI smoke path separate from the full closeout flow, scoped receipt v2 helpers for API/cluster validation, and milestone-neutral pytest basetemp

repaid_items.description: operator Web UI still depends on inline CSS/JS allowances and contribution game templates still contain browser-surface innerHTML paths
repaid_items.result: Moved operator UI CSS/JS to local static assets, removed unsafe-inline from CSP, gated reconcile/high-risk UI actions through receipt confirmation, and replaced contribution game template innerHTML clearing with DOM replaceChildren.

repaid_items.description: default scheduler wording and boot path are not fully aligned with local lease arbiter semantics; cluster-era support objects and repositories remain too visible in the flag-off path
repaid_items.result: Changed default Web and CLI wording to local scheduler lease arbiter semantics, kept legacy scheduler-authority JSON/API names compatible, moved default support import to SchedulerLeaseProjectionService, and verified flag-off construction avoids scheduler_authority and legacy support modules while flag-on lazy imports the cluster runtime.

repaid_items.description: hot-file slimming and default-path cleanup needed to reduce services.py, service_interaction_chat.py, local_scheduler_lease_arbiter.py, web_ui_components.py, local game artifacts, and core_domain/test_matrix.py toward the M67 target shape
repaid_items.result: Extracted RepositoryBundle/WorkerRuntimeBundle and service inspection/chat LLM mixins, split local scheduler handoff helpers and game templates into smaller modules, moved test matrix implementation to infra with a compatibility wrapper, removed private helper re-exports from the chat runtime facade, deleted the stale core_domain local game artifact shim in M73 preflight, and verified targeted tests plus line-count ratchets.

repaid_items.description: workflow self-development still needed tracked M67 task-card, route, batch-resume, evidence-manifest, and operator-packet proof for the active milestone rather than relying on manual execution alone
repaid_items.result: Ran real workflow task-card execution for simple, medium, and complex tasks; generated route previews, tracked evidence manifest, checkpoint, and operator packet; and fixed workflow bugs found during dogfood before closing the phase.

repaid_items.description: bounded-autonomy policy was fragmented: execute=true and auto-apply style paths needed a shared auditable authorization boundary instead of route-specific checks
repaid_items.result: Bound high-risk execute, batch-resume, reconcile apply, chat confirmation, and watchdog auto-apply paths to scoped OperatorActionReceipt consumption, rejected GET auto-apply mutation, and verified the receipt boundary through API/Web/validation closeout. Broader Command/PolicyEngine/AutomationLease consolidation remains a non-blocking M69 control-plane design concern.

repaid_items.description: adaptive routing and dynamic cluster routing had only P0 rehearsal evidence and still needed end-to-end simple/medium/complex workflow tasks plus a successful batch-resume max-workers=2 proof
repaid_items.result: Completed MiniMax/OpenCode simple lane, DeepSeek medium lane, Codex fallback, cluster_parallel complex orchestration, cluster route stats, and a batch-resume --max-workers 2 run over disjoint simple tasks.

repaid_items.description: capability invocation policy still needed one auditable decision surface tying provider live proof, write_set requirements, mutation mode, and operator receipt state together
repaid_items.result: Added capability control-plane policy decisions, exposed write_set/live-proof/receipt decisions in invocation envelopes and execution receipts, and added CLI/test coverage for allowed, blocked, and needs_receipt outcomes.

repaid_items.description: provider facts were easy to misstate: Vertex, gcloud, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, MMX, Claude, LangChain, and Shell did not share one contract registry
repaid_items.result: Added provider contract registry and CLI provider-contracts output. The docs and contract now state that Gemini CLI is not currently an adapter, Gemini-family access goes through Vertex, and gcloud is a credential/environment tool rather than a worker adapter.

repaid_items.description: batch-resume could execute in parallel but lacked a formal preflight contract for disjoint write_set auditing, dirty workspace degradation, SQLite readiness, and partial-failure resume guidance
repaid_items.result: Added a parallel batch contract, serial degradation for write_set conflicts/dirty write_set/SQLite lock, richer batch result metadata, partial failure resume hints, and cluster route stats source/dynamic counters.

repaid_items.description: workflow self-development closeout evidence and the multi-task-card phase rule were still human-convention only rather than machine-checkable
repaid_items.result: Added workflowctl governance self-development-manifest, which checks execution reports, task cards, evidence files, operator packets, git commits, and the rule that single-card phases require a single_card_exception marker.
